title: Take the 360-degree probe
author: claude
summary: A panorama of the room, taken from the table, lights and reflects in the table and chairs.
what: We took a 2048 x 1024 panorama of the room from just above the table, in the middle of the room.
why: The table and chairs are lit live, and they need a picture of the room around them to light and reflect from.
how:
- The panorama is saved in a format the web page understands.
- We worked out which way it must face so that reflections point the right way. The details are under settings.

tech.name: 360-degree probe
tech.plain: A panorama of the room taken from the table. It lights and reflects in the table and chairs.

tech.name: HDRI sky picture
tech.plain: A photo that records a huge range of brightness, used as a realistic sky and light source.

tech.name: Cycles
tech.plain: Blender's realistic renderer. It follows light the way a camera would see it.
